title: THE DELHI DECEPTION
subtitle: They called the wrong man.
author: Anantha Prakash Nithiyananthamr
description: When bestselling crime novelist Siddharth receives a menacing 2:00 AM call from the 'Indian Consulate' threatening him with immediate deportation and arrest for international money laundering, he knows something is wrong. Armed with a writer's intuition and a refusal to be a victim, he dives into the dark web of India's cyber-scam syndicates to expose the predators behind the phone lines.
